areas.name: DHA Lahore
areas.description: Defence Housing Authority is Lahore's largest and most sought-after planned community, stretching from the Cantonment towards Bedian and Barki Road. It offers the city's best security, schools, restaurants and commercial hubs, and commands the highest rents and prices.

areas.name: DHA Phase 1
areas.description: The oldest phase of DHA next to the Cantt, with mature trees, large kanal houses and quick access to Walton Road and the Ghazi Road interchange. Like the rest of DHA Lahore it has gated security, wide boulevards, parks, mosques and its own commercial areas.

areas.name: DHA Phase 2
areas.description: A quiet, established phase near LUMS and the DHA Phase 5 commercial belt, popular with faculty and families. Like the rest of DHA Lahore it has gated security, wide boulevards, parks, mosques and its own commercial areas.

areas.name: DHA Phase 3
areas.description: Home to the famous Y Block market and the Sheikh Zayed / XX commercial area, Phase 3 mixes classic kanal homes with lively food streets. Like the rest of DHA Lahore it has gated security, wide boulevards, parks, mosques and its own commercial areas.

areas.name: DHA Phase 4
areas.description: A central, well-connected phase between Phases 3 and 5 with good schools and the AA / CC commercial markets. Like the rest of DHA Lahore it has gated security, wide boulevards, parks, mosques and its own commercial areas.

areas.name: DHA Phase 5
areas.description: One of the most prestigious phases, beside LUMS, the Phase 5 CCA commercial hub and Jalal Sons / Packages-side boulevards. Like the rest of DHA Lahore it has gated security, wide boulevards, parks, mosques and its own commercial areas.

areas.name: DHA Phase 6
areas.description: A large, newer phase on the eastern side with the Main Boulevard commercial, Raya golf course nearby and Lahore Garrison University. Like the rest of DHA Lahore it has gated security, wide boulevards, parks, mosques and its own commercial areas.

areas.name: DHA Phase 7
areas.description: A fast-developing phase south of Phase 6 near the Ring Road and Bedian Road, offering newer houses at slightly lower prices. Like the rest of DHA Lahore it has gated security, wide boulevards, parks, mosques and its own commercial areas.

areas.name: DHA Phase 8
areas.description: Next to the airport, Phase 8 (including the ex Park View and Air Avenue blocks) has Broadway commercial, Goldcrest and Penta Square apartments. Like the rest of DHA Lahore it has gated security, wide boulevards, parks, mosques and its own commercial areas.

areas.name: DHA Phase 9 Town
areas.description: A compact phase of 5 and 10 marla homes near the Ring Road, giving DHA amenities at a more affordable price point. Like the rest of DHA Lahore it has gated security, wide boulevards, parks, mosques and its own commercial areas.

areas.name: DHA Phase 9 Prism
areas.description: A large developing phase along the Ring Road and Barki Road with many plots and newly built houses. Like the rest of DHA Lahore it has gated security, wide boulevards, parks, mosques and its own commercial areas.

areas.name: DHA Phase 10
areas.description: An emerging, mostly plot-based phase beyond Phase 9 Prism off Barki Road, aimed at investors and future builders. Like the rest of DHA Lahore it has gated security, wide boulevards, parks, mosques and its own commercial areas.

areas.name: DHA Phase 11 (Rahbar)
areas.description: Located on Defence Road off Raiwind Road, Phase 11 (Rahbar and Halloki Gardens) is the affordable DHA option on the western side of the city. Like the rest of DHA Lahore it has gated security, wide boulevards, parks, mosques and its own commercial areas.

areas.name: DHA Phase 12 (EME)
areas.description: The DHA EME sector on Canal Road near Thokar Niaz Baig and Multan Road, convenient for Johar Town and the motorway. Like the rest of DHA Lahore it has gated security, wide boulevards, parks, mosques and its own commercial areas.

areas.name: DHA Phase 13
areas.description: The newest DHA phase, still largely in development off Bedian Road and the southern Ring Road loop, traded mostly as files and plots. Like the rest of DHA Lahore it has gated security, wide boulevards, parks, mosques and its own commercial areas.

areas.name: DHA Raya
areas.description: An exclusive golf-course community beside DHA Phase 6 with luxury villas, apartments and the Raya Fairways commercial. Like the rest of DHA Lahore it has gated security, wide boulevards, parks, mosques and its own commercial areas.

areas.name: Askari (Lahore)
areas.description: Askari is a family of army welfare housing schemes spread across Lahore Cantt and Bedian Road. Askari societies are army-managed gated communities with strict security, maintained parks and a calm, family-oriented feel.

areas.name: Askari 1
areas.description: One of the earliest Askari schemes inside Lahore Cantt, close to Sarwar Road and the Fortress Stadium area. Askari societies are army-managed gated communities with strict security, maintained parks and a calm, family-oriented feel.

areas.name: Askari 2
areas.description: Near Tufail Road in the Cantt, minutes from CMH, Mall of Lahore and Fortress Square. Askari societies are army-managed gated communities with strict security, maintained parks and a calm, family-oriented feel.

areas.name: Askari 3
areas.description: A compact Cantt scheme with apartments and houses near the airport road. Askari societies are army-managed gated communities with strict security, maintained parks and a calm, family-oriented feel.

areas.name: Askari 4
areas.description: Apartment-focused scheme in Cantt with quick access to Gulberg and the airport. Askari societies are army-managed gated communities with strict security, maintained parks and a calm, family-oriented feel.

areas.name: Askari 5
areas.description: Located between Gulberg and the Cantt near Cavalry Ground, popular with officers' families. Askari societies are army-managed gated communities with strict security, maintained parks and a calm, family-oriented feel.

areas.name: Askari 6
areas.description: Close to the airport and DHA Phase 8, with apartments and family houses. Askari societies are army-managed gated communities with strict security, maintained parks and a calm, family-oriented feel.

areas.name: Askari 7
areas.description: A small Cantt scheme near Shami Road with apartment blocks and green belts. Askari societies are army-managed gated communities with strict security, maintained parks and a calm, family-oriented feel.

areas.name: Askari 8
areas.description: On the airport side of the Cantt with low-rise apartments and parks. Askari societies are army-managed gated communities with strict security, maintained parks and a calm, family-oriented feel.

areas.name: Askari 9
areas.description: A gated Cantt scheme near Zarrar Shaheed Road with houses and flats. Askari societies are army-managed gated communities with strict security, maintained parks and a calm, family-oriented feel.

areas.name: Askari 10
areas.description: The largest Cantt Askari scheme next to the airport, known for its multi-storey apartment sectors and family houses. Askari societies are army-managed gated communities with strict security, maintained parks and a calm, family-oriented feel.

areas.name: Askari 11
areas.description: On Bedian Road beside DHA Phases 6 and 7, offering apartments and houses at better value than neighbouring DHA. Askari societies are army-managed gated communities with strict security, maintained parks and a calm, family-oriented feel.

areas.name: Gulberg
areas.description: Gulberg is Lahore's central business and lifestyle district, home to MM Alam Road, Liberty Market and the main corporate offices. It combines old kanal bungalows with high-rise apartments and offices.

areas.name: Gulberg I
areas.description: The northern part of Gulberg near Jail Road and Kalma Chowk, with large old houses and office conversions. Close to Kinnaird, LCWU and Services Hospital.

areas.name: Gulberg II
areas.description: A leafy residential belt between Main Boulevard and the Canal with prestigious kanal homes. Walking distance to Hafeez Centre and Main Market.

areas.name: Gulberg III
areas.description: The commercial heart of Gulberg with Liberty Market, Firdous Market and MM Alam Road restaurants. Mix of apartments, offices and family houses.

areas.name: Gulberg IV
areas.description: A quieter residential section east of Liberty towards the Cantt. Popular with families wanting central Lahore without the commercial bustle.

areas.name: Gulberg V
areas.description: Bordering the Cantt and Canal, Gulberg V has upscale homes and is close to Lahore American School and the Canal Road corridor.

areas.name: Johar Town
areas.description: Johar Town is a large LDA scheme in south-west Lahore and a hub for students and young families thanks to UCP, UMT, Shaukat Khanum and Emporium Mall. It offers good-value houses, portions and flats with easy access to the Canal, Orange Line and Ring Road.

areas.name: Model Town
areas.description: Model Town is a historic, green, circular-plan society with large plots and a famous central park. It is quiet and prestigious while sitting next to Ferozepur Road, the Metro Bus and Kalma Chowk.

areas.name: Garden Town
areas.description: Garden Town is a central, established neighbourhood near Barkat Market, Kalma Chowk and the Canal. It suits families who want central Lahore with older, spacious houses.

areas.name: Faisal Town
areas.description: Faisal Town lies between Model Town and Johar Town, home to FAST University and close to Jinnah Hospital and Akbar Chowk. It offers houses and portions at upper-mid prices.

areas.name: Wapda Town
areas.description: Wapda Town is a well-planned employees' housing society near Johar Town and Raiwind Road with wide roads and parks. It offers family houses and portions at mid-range prices.

areas.name: Lahore Cantt
areas.description: Lahore Cantonment is a secure, green military-administered area with wide roads and colonial-era bungalows. It is close to the airport, CMH, Fortress Square and Gulberg.

areas.name: Bahria Town Lahore
areas.description: Bahria Town Lahore is a large self-contained gated city off Canal Road and the motorway with its own hospital, schools, the Grand Jamia Mosque and the Eiffel Tower replica. Houses are modern and prices are good value for the amenities, though it is far from central Lahore.

areas.name: Bahria Orchard
areas.description: Bahria Orchard is Bahria's more affordable gated community on Raiwind Road. It has planned blocks, parks and commercial areas, aimed at families seeking a gated lifestyle on a mid budget.

areas.name: Lake City
areas.description: Lake City is an upscale gated community on Raiwind Road with a golf course and a large lake. It offers modern houses and premium plots on the south-western edge of the city.

areas.name: Valencia Town
areas.description: Valencia is a mature, well-maintained gated society on Defence Road near Wapda Town. It offers spacious houses, parks and good security.

areas.name: EME Society
areas.description: EME Cooperative Housing Society sits on Canal Road near Thokar Niaz Baig and Multan Road. It is a secure, planned society with wide roads and family houses.

areas.name: State Life Housing Society
areas.description: State Life Housing Society is a planned society near DHA Phases 6 and 7. It offers DHA-adjacent living at lower prices.

areas.name: Paragon City
areas.description: Paragon City is a gated community off Barki Road near the Ring Road and DHA Phase 8. It offers new houses with parks and its own commercial area.

areas.name: Park View City
areas.description: Park View City is a newer gated society on Multan Road near Thokar and the motorway. It markets modern amenities and attractive installment plans.

areas.name: Central Park Housing Scheme
areas.description: Central Park is a large planned scheme on Ferozepur Road near the Ring Road. It offers affordable plots and houses with parks, a central commercial and good connectivity to DHA.

areas.name: Allama Iqbal Town
areas.description: Allama Iqbal Town is a large, established LDA neighbourhood with Moon Market and Gulshan-e-Iqbal Park. It has a dense mix of houses, portions and shops at mid-range prices.

areas.name: Township
areas.description: Township is a busy, affordable LDA neighbourhood near College Road and Green Town. It offers compact houses and portions popular with families on a budget and students.

areas.name: Gulshan-e-Ravi
areas.description: Gulshan-e-Ravi is an established residential area near Bund Road and Samanabad. It offers affordable houses and portions with an Orange Line station nearby.

areas.name: Samanabad
areas.description: Samanabad is a dense, older middle-class neighbourhood west of Ichhra. It has busy markets, schools and affordable rents with easy Orange Line access.

areas.name: Shadman
areas.description: Shadman is a central, upmarket neighbourhood off Jail Road near Services Hospital and the Shadman Market. It offers older houses on good plots close to the Mall and Gulberg.

areas.name: Garhi Shahu
areas.description: Garhi Shahu is an old central neighbourhood between the Railway Station and Dharampura. It is dense and busy with affordable flats and portions.

areas.name: Mall Road
areas.description: Mall Road is Lahore's colonial boulevard with government buildings, the High Court, Punjab Assembly and heritage shops. Residential options are mostly apartments and offices around Upper Mall.

areas.name: Cavalry Ground
areas.description: Cavalry Ground is a secure Cantt-adjacent society between Gulberg and DHA Phase 1. It is popular with families wanting central access at slightly lower prices than Gulberg.

areas.name: Sabzazar
areas.description: Sabzazar is a large LDA scheme off Multan Road with affordable houses and portions. It is well served by the Orange Line and local markets.

areas.name: PCSIR Housing Society
areas.description: PCSIR Housing Society is a planned scheme next to Johar Town and UMT. It is quiet and green with family houses at mid-range prices.

areas.name: NFC Society
areas.description: NFC Employees Cooperative Housing Society lies near Wapda Town and Johar Town. It offers well-kept streets and family homes at mid prices.

areas.name: Punjab Cooperative Housing Society
areas.description: Punjab Cooperative Housing Society sits beside DHA Phases 3 and 4 off Ghazi Road. It offers DHA-side living with lower prices and good security.

areas.name: Canal Garden
areas.description: Canal Garden is a gated society on Canal Road near Bahria Town. It offers affordable houses with parks and a planned commercial area.

areas.name: Al Rehman Garden
areas.description: Al Rehman Garden is a large budget-friendly scheme off GT Road in north-east Lahore. It offers 3 to 10 marla houses and plots at accessible prices.

areas.name: Etihad Town
areas.description: Etihad Town is a newer gated society off Raiwind Road near the Thokar side. It markets modern infrastructure and installment plans.

areas.name: Khayaban-e-Amin
areas.description: Khayaban-e-Amin is a gated community on Defence Road near the Raiwind Road junction. It has wide roads, parks and family houses.

areas.name: Bedian Road
areas.description: Bedian Road is a corridor running south-east from DHA through farmhouses and new schemes. It mixes farmhouses, Askari 11 and newer societies.

areas.name: Raiwind Road
areas.description: Raiwind Road runs south from Thokar past many universities and new housing schemes. It offers a mix of budget and mid-range housing.

areas.name: Ferozepur Road
areas.description: Ferozepur Road is a major north-south artery served by the Metro Bus from Kalma Chowk to Gajjumata. It is lined with commercial plazas, Packages Mall and Arfa Technology Park.

areas.name: Multan Road
areas.description: Multan Road is a busy western corridor from Chauburji to Thokar Niaz Baig along the Orange Line. It has affordable housing schemes and markets.

areas.name: Muslim Town
areas.description: Muslim Town is an established central area along the Canal near Wahdat Road and PU New Campus. It suits students and families wanting central access.

areas.name: Mustafa Town
areas.description: Mustafa Town is an affordable residential area off Wahdat Road near Karim Block. It offers compact houses and portions.

areas.name: Green Town
areas.description: Green Town is a budget-friendly area near Township and Ferozepur Road. It offers dense housing and local markets.

areas.name: Iqbal Avenue
areas.description: Iqbal Avenue is a planned society beside Johar Town and the Canal. It offers family houses close to UMT and Doctors Hospital.

areas.name: Revenue Society
areas.description: Revenue Employees Cooperative Housing Society is near Johar Town and Wapda Town. It is a small, quiet society with family houses.

areas.name: Tariq Gardens
areas.description: Tariq Gardens is a gated society off Canal Road near Johar Town. It offers family homes with easy access to Emporium Mall and Thokar.

areas.name: Architects Engineers Society
areas.description: Architects & Engineers Housing Society is a planned society near Johar Town and Shaukat Khanum. It has wide roads and family houses.

areas.name: Jubilee Town
areas.description: Jubilee Town is a gated society on Raiwind Road near Thokar. It offers family houses at mid prices.

areas.name: Izmir Town
areas.description: Izmir Town is a planned society off Canal and Raiwind Road near Bahria Town. It offers affordable family houses.

areas.name: Sukh Chayn Gardens
areas.description: Sukh Chayn Gardens is a well-maintained gated society off Raiwind Road near Lake City. It offers good security and modern houses.

areas.name: Ichhra
areas.description: Ichhra is a dense, historic neighbourhood along Ferozepur Road known for its huge cloth bazaar. It offers affordable flats and portions next to the Metro Bus.

areas.name: Krishan Nagar
areas.description: Krishan Nagar (Islampura) is an old central neighbourhood near Chauburji and the Mall. It offers affordable housing close to the old city.

areas.name: Mughalpura
areas.description: Mughalpura is an older eastern neighbourhood near the Railway workshops and UET. It offers affordable houses and portions.

areas.name: Baghbanpura
areas.description: Baghbanpura is a historic area beside Shalimar Gardens on GT Road. It is affordable and served by the Orange Line.

areas.name: Shahdara
areas.description: Shahdara lies across the Ravi on GT Road at the northern end of the Metro Bus line. It offers budget housing and markets.

areas.name: Walled City
areas.description: The Walled City is Lahore's historic core with the Badshahi Mosque, Lahore Fort and bustling bazaars. Housing is old and compact, mostly flats above shops.

areas.name: Divine Gardens
areas.description: Divine Gardens is a small gated society beside the airport on New Airport Road. It offers family houses close to DHA Phase 8 and the Cantt.

areas.name: Military Accounts Society
areas.description: Military Accounts Housing Society is near Wapda Town and Johar Town. It is a secure society with family houses.

areas.name: Harbanspura
areas.description: Harbanspura is an eastern neighbourhood on the Canal near GT Road and the Ring Road. It offers affordable homes.

areas.name: Ghazi Road
areas.description: Ghazi Road connects Ferozepur Road with DHA and the Cantt. Small schemes and portions here offer access to DHA at lower rents.

areas.name: Gulshan-e-Lahore
areas.description: Gulshan-e-Lahore is a planned society off Wahdat Road near PU New Campus. It offers houses at mid prices close to the Canal.
